chunks: 5648 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Saʿd ibn Abī Khalaf, from one of the companions of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding daughters of a sister and a grandfather,
He said: "The daughters of the sister receive one-third, and whatever remains belongs to the grandfather."

key_terms.الْجَدِّ: the grandfather who receives the remainder of the inheritance
key_terms.بَنَاتِ الْأُخْتِ: the daughters of the sister as heirs in an inheritance case

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between the daughters of a sister and a grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when the heirs are the daughters of a sister and a grandfather. It states that the daughters of the sister receive one-third of the estate, while the remainder goes to the grandfather.
